notes: «عن أبيه» is a bare relation (rule 7); «حدثنا أبو السليل» is the father's own teacher line, so the chain continues from him
«يحدثه عن أبي موسى» : «يحدثه» is a verb, so زهدم is followed by Abu Musa, the Companion who relays the saying
«بنحو حديث جرير» refers to another report and names no transmitter here: left out
